full_judgment: 2. Qari Abdus Samad, predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners, instituted a suit in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Narsingdi for cancellation of a registered deed of sale bearing No. 2347 dated 20-3-91 alleging, inter alia, that he is the absolute owner of the suit property measuring 0.4 decimals of land, which was earlier purchased by him with his own money. It was further contended that after the aforesaid purchase he constructed pucca buildings on the suit land and since then he has been living there with the members of his family for over twelve years. It was also contended that the plaintiff is the Khadem of Maijbhandari Peer Shaheb and he holds annual Urs Sharif of Maijbhandari Peer Shaheb and arranges other religious festivals in his house. As he was issueless he brought the defendant, who is the son of his brother-in-law, to his house and brought him up as his son. The plaintiff earlier filed Title Suit No. 79 of 1990 in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Narsingdi for revocation of a deed of gift bearing No. 9385 dated 3-9-85, which was earlier executed in favour of his adopted daughter Johra Begum. Eventually the said deed of gift was cancelled by a decree of the Court. It was further contended that the present defendant was tadbirkar of the aforesaid suit and in that capacity he obtained signatures from the plaintiff on various papers. It subsequently transpired that the defendant fraudulently and collusively created a sale deed in respect of the suit property bearing deed No. 2347 dated 5-10-92 for illegally grabbing the suit property. It was further contended that the sale-deed in question is false and fabricated and consequently it is of no legal consequence.
